name: Comprehensive Crypto Removal from News Scanner (Phase 2)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-19: 'we need to get rid of any and all crypto news sources from the news scanner process [...] we're still seeing crypto news dominating' despite the 2026-05-12 fix (commit c72c9368a) which cut INGESTION + added SOURCE BLOCKLIST + RECENCY FLOOR. Defense-in-depth gap: prior fix did NOT remove crypto from the RANKING / NORMALIZATION / GPT-PROMPTING layers. Non-blocked sources (TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Reuters, Yahoo Finance, MarketWatch, CNBC) all cover crypto news -- those stories still flow through Layer 2 -> Layer 3, get normalized into crypto/bitcoin keyword buckets via KEYWORD_NORMALIZATION, and are explicitly prompted as preferred portal keywords. This project tears out crypto presence at all 4 layers structurally: TOP_20_KEYWORDS removal, KEYWORD_NORMALIZATION crypto-variant block removal, BLOCKED_SOURCES extension + threshold reduction, CRYPTO_CAP -> BANNED_KEYWORDS hard-drop-at-prefilter conversion, content-level CRYPTO_RAW_PATTERN regex filter, comprehensive GPT prompt scrub including explicit EXCLUSION instruction.
phase: Phase 1 -- ADHC_CRYPCT.002 (v2.9.11) IN FLIGHT 2026-05-20. .001 (comprehensive 4-layer crypto removal) shipped + deployed; its +24h verification (DS 0.1.0) surfaced 2 residual crypto leak paths. CTO 1.0.0_SA_CTO GO'd a v2.9.11 follow-on directly (CTO-direct project, Andrew-authorized single-TO origin; DS had it fully scoped from the verification, needed only the architectural GO -- no decomposition). ADHC_CRYPCT.002 (DS 0.1.0_DS_MarketIntelligence) formalized base-lane by 2.0.0_SA_COO as the TO record (not a gate -- DS already executing on the CTO GO). .002 scope, both in news_layer3_curation/lambda_function.py: Fix #1 -- dilution-proof topic gate (defining-article anchor check: drop topic if its defining article is from a BLOCKED_SOURCE regardless of ratio; class fix for the `_is_blocked_source_dominated` L462 ratio-gate dilution bypass); Fix #2 -- article-level scrub (drop blocked-source / CRYPTO_RAW_PATTERN articles from top_articles on KEPT topics). Plus a Fix-#1 over-drop observability AC (log every anchor-drop) + standard +24h verification before close. CBDC keyword: Andrew ruled NO to a BANNED_KEYWORDS add (CBDC = monetary policy, in-scope). Deploys news-v2.9.11. RAVC2 to CTO base direct.
blocking: None -- ADHC_CRYPCT.002 (v2.9.11) in flight, DS executing on CTO-direct GO. Brief verdict + post-deploy 3-cycle log check + +24h verification (incl. Fix-#1 over-drop audit) close the project.
pipeline: news-pipeline (news_layer3_curation Lambda primary + news_trending_analysis Lambda audit)
